name: Sondy
author: innovagroup

sections.description: Sondy adds provider and location directory shortcodes to your WordPress site, powered by the PowrPractice API. Display searchable provider and location listings, detail pages, and pretty URL rewrites.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Sondy and enter your API base URL and token.
  4. Select the pages that host the provider and location shortcodes.
